hospitalization_proxy.meaning: ILINet/FluSurv training proxy: original log(rate+1) regression, rate rounded to 2 decimals, original population, count rounding, dates through 2019-06-30 shifted 728 days. Stored unleveled; each era is leveled to the current NHSN regime at forecast time.

hospitalization_calibration.meaning: Unshifted ILINet/FluSurv predictor counts before count rounding, every week through April 2026 (frozen). The yardstick for leveling each era of the hospitalization history to the current NHSN regime.

ilinet_normalized.meaning: Original per-location bestNormalize(ILI+1) values from the April 25, 2026 study input. These are transformed inputs, not raw percentages. Also used to build the ED training proxy (pooled ED log-odds regression, dates through 2019-06-30 shifted 728 days).
